samples.title: Lớp học trực tuyến
samples.prompt: Your friend invited you to an online study workshop, but you cannot attend. Write to apologise, explain your reason, and suggest another way to meet or learn about the topic.
requirementsVi: Cảm ơn và từ chối lịch sự.
Nêu lý do cụ thể.
Đề nghị dịp khác hoặc cách tìm hiểu thay thế.
samples.summaryVi: Học online giúp linh hoạt giờ học; cần thảo luận và hỗ trợ để tránh học một mình.

paragraphs.label: Từ chối
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

Thank you very much for inviting me to an online study workshop. It sounds interesting, especially because students can fit learning around work and family responsibilities. Unfortunately, I will not be able to join you on Saturday at nine in the morning.
paragraphs.noteVi: Lời cảm ơn rồi báo không tham gia được.

paragraphs.label: Lý do
paragraphs.text: I have to attend a family appointment that was arranged earlier. This was arranged earlier, and I cannot change it now. I realise that you may already have made plans, so I wanted to tell you as soon as possible rather than leave you waiting for an answer.
paragraphs.noteVi: Lý do cụ thể và tôn trọng sắp xếp của bạn.

paragraphs.label: Phương án khác
paragraphs.text: Could we meet at a cafe the following weekend instead? You could tell me what you learned when you tried to try a short recorded lesson and discuss it in a small group. I would be particularly interested in the idea that students can fit learning around work and family responsibilities. If there are notes or a short recording from the session, I would be happy to read or watch them first.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đề nghị thời điểm khác và giữ kết nối với chủ đề.

paragraphs.label: Kết thư
paragraphs.text:
I am sorry to miss this opportunity, but I hope you have a great time. Please let me know whether the new plan suits you.

Best wishes,
Minh
paragraphs.noteVi: Xin lỗi, chúc vui và xin phản hồi.
